title: Stability of Vacuum and Quantum Dynamics in Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
summary: Canonical quantization on scalar and Maxwell fields is studied for the stability of vacuum and construction of quantum dynamics in Anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The $ξRφ^2$ term in the Lagrangian of scalar field with $ξ> 5/48$ (mass term just introduces shift of $ξ$) can cause the spectrum of the self-adjoint Hamiltonian with negative value not bounded from below. The degrees of freedom corresponding to the negative values are constrained system and are ambiguous in space direction and in commutation relation.
